value_stream.name: Trade-In, Buy-Back & Certified Pre-Owned Product Resale

Automation Opportunity: - Intake/ownership-verification app; serial-vs-stolen-list check; custody-chain capture
Controls: - CTL-696 (ensure controlled execution — Take-Back, Inspection, Refurbishment & Certification (PA-155.2).)
- CTL-696: ownership/identity verified (anti-theft VS-23); eligibility confirmed (W4578); title transferred & documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-07/VS-08 (store/POS), VS-05 (inventory), VS-23 (LP), VS-22 (compliance), W4578 (eligibility), W4580 (credit), W4586 (inspection)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stolen-goods risk**: Receiving stolen property → legal/loss (VS-23/VS-100); mitigated by ownership/ID verification & serial check
- **Title-transfer risk**: Ambiguous ownership → later dispute; mitigated by documented title transfer & terms

steps.activity: Stores/Service Center take physical custody of the trade-in item, verify ownership/identity (anti-theft — avoid receiving stolen goods VS-23), and confirm eligibility (W4578)
Stores/POS issue the trade-in credit (W4580), record the take-back (customer, item, valuation, channel), and transfer title/ownership to BuildRight
Inventory/Stores move the item to pre-owned intake stock (VS-05/W4584) and route to inspection (W4586), with custody chain documented

workflows.name: Intake Inspection, Safety Screen & Data Wipe

Automation Opportunity: - Inspection/safety-checklist app; data-wipe documentation; recall-list integration (VS-89)
Controls: - CTL-82 (ensure trade-in device integrity & data wipe.)
- CTL-696: safety-screened (no recalled/DG/unsafe VS-89/VS-114); data wiped (VS-91); hazmat handled (VS-24)
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-31 (quality), VS-91 (privacy), VS-24/VS-114 (HSE/DG), VS-89 (recall), W4585 (intake), W4587 (triage)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Safety-intake risk**: Unsafe item enters refurbishment → injury/fire; mitigated by safety screen & DG handling (VS-114/VS-24)
- **Privacy-residual risk**: Customer data on smart items; mitigated by certified data wipe (VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); quality (VS-31); privacy (VS-91); HSE (VS-24); DG (VS-114); recall (VS-89)

steps.activity: Service Center/Quality inspect the item (function, cosmetic, completeness, age/condition per W4579 grading) and safety-screen (no recalled VS-89, no DG/battery hazard VS-114, electrical safety)
Service Center/Privacy perform data wipe/factory reset on smart appliances/tools with stored data (VS-91 RA 10173), documenting sanitization
Service Center/HSE handle any intake hazmat (battery/chemical VS-114/VS-24) safely, and route the item to triage (W4587)

Automation Opportunity: - Economics-driven triage rules; disposition-routing app; capacity/analytics
Controls: - CTL-696 (ensure controlled execution — Take-Back, Inspection, Refurbishment & Certification (PA-155.2).)
- CTL-696: disposition economics-driven (W4582); routes correct (refurb/parts/recycle); recorded for analytics/inventory
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-01 (merch), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-73 (circular), VS-05 (inventory), W4582 (economics), W4586 (inspection), W4588/W4590 (routes)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-disposition risk**: Refurbishing uneconomic items, or recycling refurbishable ones; mitigated by unit-economics-driven triage
- **Triage-bottleneck risk**: Items pile up pre-disposition; mitigated by triage SLA & capacity
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); merchandising (VS-01); finance (VS-17.4); circular (VS-73); inventory (VS-05)

steps.activity: Service Center/Merchandising triage each item to a disposition (refurbish-to-certify W4588, parts-harvest W4590, recycle/dispose VS-73) based on inspection (W4586) & unit economics (W4582)
Finance/Service Center confirm the disposition is economic (refurb cost vs resale value W4582), re-routing uneconomic items to parts/recycle
Service Center route the item (to refurb bench W4588, parts W4590, or recycle VS-73), recording the disposition for analytics (W4599) & inventory (VS-05)

Automation Opportunity: - Refurb-workflow/cost-capture app; parts-availability check; quality-verification checklist
Controls: - CTL-696 (ensure controlled execution — Take-Back, Inspection, Refurbishment & Certification (PA-155.2).)
- CTL-696: refurbishment to standard & quality-verified (VS-31); cost captured (W4582); HSE-compliant (W4592)
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-31 (quality), VS-05 (parts), VS-03 (vendor), VS-17 (finance), VS-24/W4592 (HSE), W4582 (cost), W4589 (certification)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Quality-failure risk**: Refurbished item fails in use → warranty/safety (W4583/VS-53); mitigated by VS-31 quality verification & W4589 certification
- **Cost-overrun risk**: Refurb exceeds estimate → margin loss (W4582); mitigated by cost tracking & stop-loss
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); quality (VS-31); inventory/parts (VS-05); vendor service (VS-03); finance (VS-17); HSE (VS-24/W4592)

steps.activity: Service Center diagnose & execute refurbishment (repair, replace worn parts from stock VS-05 or vendor VS-03, refinish/clean, re-battery for cordless), per grade target (W4579)
Service Center/Quality verify refurbishment meets function/cosmetic standard (VS-31), capturing parts/labor cost for unit economics (W4582/W4591)
Service Center route the refurbished item to certification (W4589), with HSE compliance during processing (W4592)

Automation Opportunity: - Certification-test checklist; certificate/warranty generation; certified-label/serial issuance (VS-151)
Controls: - CTL-82 (ensure trade-in device integrity & data wipe.)
- CTL-696: certification testing rigorous w/ reject criteria; certificate & warranty issued (W4583); labeled/serial-tracked (VS-151)
Cross-references: - links to VS-31 (quality), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-53 (warranty), VS-151 (auto-ID), VS-05 (inventory), W4579 (grading), W4583 (warranty), W4581 (price), W4593 (listing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **False-certify risk**: Item certified that shouldn't be → warranty/safety failure (VS-53/VS-26); mitigated by rigorous testing & reject criteria
- **Labeling-error risk**: Certified item mislabeled; mitigated by Auto-ID/serial control (VS-151)
System Touchpoints: - Quality (VS-31); service center (VS-12.1); warranty (VS-53); auto-ID/labeling (VS-151); inventory (VS-05); merchandising (VS-01)

steps.activity: Quality/Service Center run certification testing (function, safety/electrical, performance vs spec), assign the final grade (A/B/C per W4579), and decide certify vs reject
Warranty/Merchandising issue the certified-pre-owned certificate & warranty (W4583 terms), and Auto-ID applies the certified-pre-owned label/serial (VS-151/W4584)
Inventory/Merchandising move the certified item to resale stock (VS-05/W4584) at the W4581 price, ready for listing (W4593)

fields.Trigger: Triage to parts/recycle (W4587); reject from certification (W4589)

Automation Opportunity: - Parts-catalog/harvest app; recycle/e-waste partner routing; circular-impact tracking
Controls: - CTL-82 (ensure trade-in device integrity & data wipe.)
- CTL-696: parts harvested where economic; hazmat responsibly disposed (VS-114/VS-73); circular impact captured (VS-25)
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-73 (circular/waste), VS-05 (inventory), VS-24/VS-114 (HSE/DG), VS-17 (finance), VS-25 (ESG), W4587 (triage), W4589 (reject)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hazmat-mishandling risk**: Battery/chemical parts disposed improperly → environmental/fine (VS-114/VS-73); mitigated by hazmat-handling & certified e-waste partners
- **Value-loss risk**: Usable parts discarded; mitigated by parts-harvest discipline
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); circular/waste (VS-73); inventory (VS-05); HSE/DG (VS-24/VS-114); finance (VS-17); ESG (VS-25)

steps.activity: Service Center harvest usable parts from non-certifiable/reject items (for refurbishment spares), cataloging to parts inventory (VS-05)
Service Center/Circular route remaining material to recycling/responsible disposal (VS-73), with DG/hazmat handling (VS-114/VS-24) for batteries/chemicals
Finance/Circular account parts-harvest value & disposal cost, capture circular-economy impact (diverted-from-waste), and report (VS-25/VS-73)

workflows.name: Refurbishment Quality, Cost Tracking & Service-Center Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Refurb-workflow/WIP tracking; cost-capture automation; ops-performance dashboards
Controls: - CTL-82 (ensure trade-in device integrity & data wipe.)
- CTL-696: refurb ops capacity-planned & quality-controlled (VS-12.1/VS-31); cost/yield tracked (W4582); continuously improved (VS-133)
Cross-references: - links to VS-12.1 (service center), VS-31 (quality), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-133 (OpEx), VS-05 (inventory), W4582 (cost), W4599 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Capacity-bottleneck risk**: Refurb backlog → inventory tie-up; mitigated by workload planning & capacity mgmt
- **Quality-drift risk**: Inconsistent refurb quality → returns/warranty (VS-53); mitigated by QC & standard work (VS-133)
System Touchpoints: - Service center (VS-12.1); quality (VS-31); finance (VS-17.4); OpEx (VS-133); inventory (VS-05); data (VS-28)

steps.activity: Service Center/Quality run refurbishment operations (workload planning, technician scheduling, WIP tracking, quality control), leveraging VS-12.1 service-center capability
Finance/Data track refurbishment cost (labor, parts, overhead per item/category W4582), yield, and throughput, feeding unit economics & analytics (W4599)
OpEx/Service Center drive continuous improvement (process efficiency, cost reduction, yield improvement) per VS-133, and report ops performance

Automation Opportunity: - HSE training/exposure tracking; incident management; hazmat-disposal documentation
Controls: - CTL-696 (ensure controlled execution — Take-Back, Inspection, Refurbishment & Certification (PA-155.2).)
- CTL-696: refurbisher safety standards (VS-24/VS-114); technicians trained/PPE'd; hazmat compliantly handled (VS-114/VS-73)
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-12.1 (service center), VS-114 (DG), VS-83 (occupational health), VS-22/VS-21 (compliance/audit), W4586 (intake safety), W4590 (hazmat disposal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Technician-injury risk**: Electrical/chemical/battery injury; mitigated by PPE, training, safe-test procedures (VS-24)
- **Hazmat-compliance risk**: Improper battery/chemical handling → environmental/fine (VS-114); mitigated by hazmat procedures & certified disposal
System Touchpoints: - HSE (VS-24); service center (VS-12.1); DG (VS-114); occupational health (VS-83); compliance (VS-22); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: HSE/Service Center set refurbisher safety standards (electrical test safety, battery/lithium handling VS-114, PPE, ergonomic), per VS-24/DG rules
HSE/Occupational Health train technicians, monitor exposures (electrical, chemical, battery), and manage incidents (VS-24/VS-83)
HSE/DG manage refurbishment hazmat (battery/chemical storage, e-waste disposal VS-114/VS-73), and ensure compliance/audit (VS-22/VS-21)
